title: 2026 Navier–Stokes similarity observables
description: Renderer of the similarity-scale construction from the 2026 forced Navier–Stokes blow-up. h and tau are the real scientific controls from the paper's similarity scaling. twist/etaFreq are observation-phase controls. The core similarity relations (radial ~ tau^1/2, axial ~ tau^(1/2-h), velocity ~ tau^(-1/2-h)) are immutable; the parameters that feed them are the search space.
core_statement: similarity relations immutable; h, tau, twist, etaFreq mutate within paper-justified bounds

h.provenance: similarity exponent from the blow-up construction; controls axial/velocity scaling ratio. Paper demonstrates blow-up for h in (0, 1/2); demo uses h=0.006.

tau.provenance: similarity time scale; drives radial/axial/velocity scaling. Log-scale because tau enters as powers. Paper construction is valid for tau > 0.

twist.provenance: azimuthal winding rate; how many times the similarity solution wraps around the axis during the observation window.

etaFreq.provenance: frequency of the eta-dependent pulse pattern; controls how many radial nodes appear in the similarity solution visualization.

density.provenance: particle draw density; how many of the N scaffold points are rendered.

exposure.provenance: alpha gain on rendered points; visual only.
